Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

Versatile design suitable for creating a focal point in any room

Designed to bring festive grandeur to rooms with high ceilings, this Fraser Fir Christmas Tree stands a majestic 10ft tall and is ideal for spacious homes, entrance halls, and lobbies. Its 2,531 PE and PVC tips create a full, richly layered shape with abundant space for lights and decorations

LIFELIKE MIXED FOLIAGE: Combining two different tip styles gives the Fraser Fir a realistic forest feel. Its 394 moulded PE tips recreate the definition of natural needles, while 2,137 PVC tips add texture and density throughout the branches for a richly layered look.

FIVE MANAGEABLE SECTIONS: Despite its impressive scale, the tree is divided into five sections to simplify handling and setup. Connect the pole sections in sequence, lower the hinged branches gently into place, then fluff the individual tips to create a stunning centrepiece.

SECURE, FLOOR-FRIENDLY BASE: Measuring 80cm wide, the metal stand provides dependable support and stability for this towering tree. Coloured green to blend with the foliage, it has three eyebolts to secure the central pole, plus rubber feet for added grip and floor protection.

This Grand Fir Christmas tree features a classic conical silhouette with 2,615 branch tips, combining pointed and rounded needle shapes for a natural, textured look that mimics a real forest pine. Standing on a sturdy 32mm steel trunk with a 70cm five-leg metal base, it stays solid and secure even when fully decorated. The 3-section plug-in design allows for tool-free assembly, and the branches fold flat for compact storage after the season. Perfect for living rooms, festive gatherings, or as a striking centrepiece in shop windows and office receptions – this tree brings a rich, full, and timeless Christmas presence to any indoor space.
Classic Grand Fir Shape: Inspired by the majestic Grand Fir, a species known for its long, glossy needles and classic conical silhouette. Unlike trendy sculpted trees, this one delivers the traditional Christmas tree look that never goes out of style.
Two Needle Types: Most artificial trees use one type of needle. We use two needle types. The pointed tips mimic the sharp outer needles of a wild pine, while the rounded tips copy the softer, fuller needles found deeper inside. This mix creates a richer, more textured look that captures the true character of a real Grand Fir, not a cheap, one-dimensional copy.
The Densest Tree: With 2,615 branch tips, this tree leaves zero gaps. More tips mean more places to hang your favourite ornaments, more volume, and a more luxurious presence that fills your entire living room corner. It's the kind of tree that creates a stunning festive atmosphere.
Heavy-Duty Steel Stand: Built with a 32mm thick steel centre pole and a 70cm 5-leg metal base, this tree stands firm even when fully loaded with decorations.
Effortless Assembly and Storage: This tree features a clever 3-section, plug-in design – simply stack the three pre-labelled sections (bottom, middle, top) one by one, no tools required. When the festive season ends, the sections pull apart easily, taking up minimal space in storage. Ready to use again for many Christmases to come.
Guarantee - 1 year

5051641498850.sourceDescription:
Hugely popular in America and increasingly loved in the UK, the Fraser Fir is chosen for its dense, bushy, silvery-green foliage and soft needles that are kind on hands when decorating. It gives off a sweet, citrusy scent that fills your home for as long as the tree is indoors, and its strong, upward-angled branches make decorating easy and hold heavier ornaments without trouble. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Fraser Fir
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
GREAT SHAPE & FRAGRANCE - The Fraser Fir owes much of its popularity to its strong base, thick branches and citrusy-sweet scent

Product Introduction
Add sweet holiday vibes for your family with this set of 2D flat acrylic Christmas hanging ornaments. The cute printed Santa and snowman patterns are kid-friendly, matched with classic red and white Christmas colors. Made of smooth flat
 acrylic sheet with double-sided printing, the patterns look nice from any angle. Each ornament has a golden hanging cord, children can join you to hang them on the tree together. Easy to store and reuse year after year.

 Material: Safe flat acrylic sheet (2D)
 Size: 8cm × 8cm / 3.15in × 3.15in
 Style: Assorted snowman & Santa prints
 Feature: Double-sided printing
 Fitting: Gold hanging string

Perfect for family Christmas tree, kids’ bedroom, living room, fireplace, holiday photo backdrop. Great for family DIY decoration activities, kids Christmas gifts and classroom festive decor.
Notes

Double-sided HD printing, clear cute patterns visible from both sides
Come with golden hanging cords, ready to hang on Christmas tree directly
Ideal for holiday decor, Christmas party and festive gifts for family

5052532153650.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red and Green. Stated size: 6 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive red and green baubles add colour and detail to your Christmas tree.
Hanging format allows easy placement on branches or in coordinated displays.
Decorative plastic ornaments create a focal point for seasonal arrangements.
Compact 6 cm size offers flexible styling for various display settings.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 1x Christmas bauble
Hanger included

Christmas Elf Decoration
This Christmas elf decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The yellow finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Flexible Shaping
The flexible construction lets you arrange the decorative sections to suit the available display space. Shape the parts gently as directed to create the outline you want, whether the piece is shown alone or within a larger seasonal grouping.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

5056797098350.sourceDescription:
Bring a little winter magic indoors with this snow swirl lantern from MySmartBuy. A warm white LED lights up swirling glitter inside, creating a sparkling, snow-globe effect that is mesmerising to watch on a dark winter evening. Being battery operated, it can sit anywhere without trailing cables: on a mantelpiece, a shelf, a side table or a windowsill, where its glow can be seen from outside. The traditional lantern shape suits classic and country-style homes, and makes a lovely gift for anyone who loves seasonal decor. It runs on 3 x AA batteries (not included), so there are no cables to trail and no need for a nearby socket. Festive lights are a simple way to bring warmth and atmosphere to dark winter evenings. Group them with candles, greenery and decorations, place them where they can be seen from outside, or use them to create a cosy corner for the family to enjoy throughout December. A charming, whimsical piece of festive decor that also makes a lovely Christmas gift. At a glance: snow swirl lantern | swirling glitter effect | warm white LED | battery operated, 3 x AA (not included) | indoor use.
SNOW SWIRL LANTERN : A warm white LED lights swirling glitter for a sparkling, snow-globe effect.
MAGICAL WINTER DISPLAY : A cosy, whimsical festive glow that is mesmerising to watch.
PERFECT PLACEMENT : Lovely on mantelpieces, shelves, tables and windowsills.
BATTERY OPERATED : Runs on 3 x AA batteries (not included), so there are no trailing cables and no need for a nearby socket.

5056797097650.variantName: MySmartBuy Outdoor Pre-Lit Flower Effect Tree, Warm White Micro LED
5056797097650.sourceDescription:
Create an enchanting garden display with this outdoor pre-lit tree from MySmartBuy. Thousands of warm white micro LEDs sit on fine copper wire branches, clustering together to create a delicate, dazzling flower-like effect that sparkles beautifully after dark. It is available in 150cm with 2000 micro LEDs or 180cm with 3000 micro LEDs. The sturdy metal base keeps it stable on patios, terraces and pathways, and it makes an elegant feature beside the front door or in a covered entrance. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket. Light up trees are a clever way to add festive height and impact without the mess of a real tree. Use one as a centrepiece, place a pair either side of a doorway, or combine different sizes to create a glowing forest effect in the garden or a large room. A show-stopping alternative to a traditional tree, it brings instant festive impact with none of the needles, and can be enjoyed year after year. At a glance: flower effect tree | warm white micro LEDs on copper wire | 150cm (2000 LEDs) or 180cm (3000 LEDs) | sturdy metal base | 5m lead cable | BS IP20 transformer | outdoor use.

5056797099050.sourceDescription:
Recreate the look of glistening winter icicles with these 320 LED icicle lights from MySmartBuy. Warm white LEDs hang in a realistic mixed-drop design on a transparent cable. Hang them along roofs, gutters, windows, fences and porches. They are supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights them for 8 hours and then switches them off for 16 hours, so they come on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Festive lights are among the most versatile decorations you can own. Use them to outline windows and doors, wrap trees and railings, or layer them with light up figures and wreaths to tie a whole display together. Versatile and easy to use, they are a quick way to transform your home and garden for the festive season, and can be brought out again year after year. TRANSPARENT CABLE : Blends discreetly into your display.

Elevate your seasonal display with this elegant Christmas tree skirt, the perfect solution for concealing plain bases, unsightly wires, and metal stands. Crafted from durable, weather-resistant plastic, it features a timeless basket weave pattern in a natural brown finish that adds warm, rustic charm to your home decor. The clever design assembles in seconds, allowing for a stress-free setup without the need to lift or tilt your tree. Measuring 65cm in bottom diameter, 50cm in top diameter and 25cm in height, it is ideally sized for artificial and real Christmas trees. Once celebrations conclude, simply disassemble the collar to store it away in a minimal space until next year.
CONCEAL UNSIGHTLY STANDS: Effortlessly hide metal or plastic tree feet, wires, and base mess. This rattan effect Christmas tree collar ensures your festive display looks polished and professionally finished.
DURABLE WOVEN DESIGN: Crafted from high quality weather resistant plastic, this Christmas tree skirt offers the elegant look of a woven basket. It provides long lasting charm without any risk of warping.
HASSLE FREE ASSEMBLY: The simple design allows for a quick tool free setup without the need to lift your tree. The Christmas tree collar is lightweight, portable, and packs away efficiently for easy storage.
VERSATILE FESTIVE DECOR: Measuring 65cm in bottom diameter, 50cm in top diameter and 25cm in height, this collar complements artificial or real trees. The natural brown tone suits any festive theme.
For Indoor & outdoor Use

This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Wind Resistant
The wind resistant construction adds a covering layer for the stated use. It is a useful detail when choosing an accessory for changing conditions in the intended setting.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. Dimensions: 100 x 55 x 120 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
